non_goals: No evaluator (evaluate_convergent_review_prompt.py) changes; its --isolation-adapter flag already exists and its no-follow/exclusive/revalidation/convergence/replay/publication semantics stay byte-identical.
No schema, packet, ledger, replay, suppression, or template changes; no consumer-facing surface change.

No host security-control changes (sysctl/seccomp/AppArmor/userns) locally or in CI; the existing CI sysctl step is neither used as authority nor altered. The production adapter surface creates only restrict-only containers (--network none, cap-drop all, no-new-privileges, read-only rootfs, no host/PID/shared mounts, no daemon socket mounted, no ambient environment/config/home forwarding). Omission-control containers exist only inside the test suite as short-lived ephemeral QA containers over scratch data with no daemon socket, no host mounts and no sysctl/seccomp/apparmor change — they are labelled mutant controls proving each boundary layer load-bearing, not production surface.
No untrusted-input-selectable image/mount/flags; no auto-pull inside the adapter (explicit reviewed pull step only); no ad hoc local wrapper outside the repo.

No live model observation runner, no runtime-session broker, no no-network relaxation, no reminting of fixture observations as canonical trials; the shared qualification gap (trusted released installation + selected-runtime controls + original model/packet/replay evidence) is explicitly not claimed by this feature.

No removal, renaming, or weakening of the five native obligations; unsupported stays nonzero; no manufactured green; no edits to installed .nizam payload; no merge, tag, or release; no historical evidence rewriting.

verification.command:
S=$(mktemp -d); printf '#!/bin/sh
exit 1
' > "$S/docker"; chmod +x "$S/docker"; PATH="$S:$PATH" bash tools/docker_trial_sandbox.sh --probe; A=$?; printf '#!/bin/sh
[ "$1" = image ] && exit 1
exit 0
' > "$S/docker"; PATH="$S:$PATH" bash tools/docker_trial_sandbox.sh --probe; B=$?; rm -rf "$S"; test "$A" -eq 3 -a "$B" -eq 3
verification.expected_exit: 0 overall; each simulated probe failure (daemon-unreachable; image-absent) exits 3 with a one-line reason captured in evidence; the trailing test is the final authoritative command
